findings.description: bz_16–bz_23 match KD-3 two-pass placeholder digest. All 23 packages store 64-hex checksums. bz_01–bz_15 (15) do not reproduce under KD-3 two-pass; original Wave 1 serializer is unchanged and was not rewritten.
findings.recommendation: Keep checksums immutable. Do not regenerate Wave 1 digests in QC-1.

findings.description: Fleet PVP-RELEASE records Golden Dataset as not_applicable until engine wiring.
findings.recommendation: Keep warning. Wire Golden Dataset in an engine sprint without mutating sealed packages.

findings.description: Sealed bz_16–bz_23 paths are not imported by engines. Interpretation/narrative/report engines still reference legacy 07_sentence_library trees.
findings.recommendation: Add read-only adapters in a later engine sprint. Do not edit bz packages to match engines.

findings.description: Integration layer pipelines exist (system_flow=True, report=True) but do not cite bz_16–bz_23 package ids (mentions_bz_16_23=False).
findings.recommendation: Document consumption in a later integration sprint. Do not edit RX freeze docs in QC-1 beyond this audit.

findings.description: Packages without assets/published_outputs.json: bz_01_strength_core, bz_02_seasonal_core, bz_03_temperature_core, bz_04_pattern_core. Downstream still names implicit scores via DEPENDENCIES signals.
findings.recommendation: Backfill publish assets only via new SemVer after RM policy. Do not mutate sealed 1.0.0/1.2.0 in QC-1.

findings.description: bz_01 package_version is 1.2.0; peers are 1.0.0. Schema/knowledge/compatibility remain 2.0.0/1.0.0/1.0.0.
findings.recommendation: Record as known SemVer skew. Do not rebase bz_01 in this sprint.

findings.description: Luck foundation has rule_count=0, evidence_count=0, reasoning_chains=0, no reasoning/index.json.
findings.recommendation: Ship luck analytical rules as a new package. Do not convert foundation into an analytical pack in place.

findings.description: bz_20–bz_23 store identifier graphs only; evidence catalogs are empty by design.
findings.recommendation: Do not invent analytical evidence for presentation packs.

findings.description: Primary domain_id count is 13/34 taxonomy domains. Calendar and Shen Sha packages are absent.
findings.recommendation: Open new packages for missing domains. Do not overload existing sealed packs.

findings.description: No dependency cycles. All declared edges are optional. Unknown dependency targets: none.
findings.recommendation: Keep required arrays empty unless a later sprint owns a hard runtime coupling.

findings.description: No duplicate cross-package published signals. Repeated local catalog names (['placeholder_catalog']) are per-package catalogs.
findings.recommendation: Keep shared pipeline signal names unique. Local *_catalog names may repeat per pack.
